en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2205 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Whoever performs the Hajj of Islam has untied a knot of the Fire from around their neck. Whoever performs two Hajj will remain in goodness until they die. And whoever performs three consecutive Hajj, whether they perform another Hajj afterward or not, is regarded as one devoted to Hajj."
